integrity: All analytic sign claims have displayed finite polynomial proofs. A standalone standard-library exact-arithmetic checker compares both model rules to independent full configuration enumeration. The result is not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies linear homogeneous orientation perturbations in explicitly defined seven-site annealed models; it does not prove stability of the spatial active lattice gas, nonlinear ordering, correlated neighborhoods, global phase boundaries, or marginal cases.
title: A tie-breaking dichotomy for the homogeneous alignment spinodal of a seven-site lattice gas
